def correlation(x, y):
    n = len(x)
    mean_x = sum(x) / n
    mean_y = sum(y) / n
    
    numerator = sum((x[i] - mean_x) * (y[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n))
    denom_x = math.sqrt(sum((x[i] - mean_x) ** 2 for i in range(n)))
    denom_y = math.sqrt(sum((y[i] - mean_y) ** 2 for i in range(n)))
    
    return numerator / (denom_x * denom_y)

# Calculate correlation coefficient

print(f"Correlation coefficient (r_TM): {r_TM}")

# Calculate correlation with year
r_TY = correlation(treasury_yields, years)

print(f"r_MY (Moody's-Year): {r_MY}")

partial_corr = (r_TM - r_TY * r_MY) / math.sqrt((1 - r_TY**2) * (1 - r_MY**2))
